32/G.goal: Explain the user-centered, iterative interactive system development lifecycle as the process that produces an executable, usable XR system through controlled iteration.
32/G.achieves: Provides the foundational development-process knowledge that supports understanding and implementing an XR system through the course's case-study approach.

32/O1.goal: Explain why usable interactive XR systems require a structured, user-centered software development lifecycle.
32/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a rationale for approaching XR development systematically, preparing them to follow the course's case-study-based development stages.

32/O2.goal: Describe how the iterative interactive system development lifecycle moves from requirements to implementation and usability evaluation while limiting extra iteration loops.
32/O2.achieves: Enables the learner to identify the main development stages and iteration points for an XR system and to reason about where to prototype, test, evaluate usability, and control development cost and turnaround time.
